task.description: Implement ISS-0532 option (b): point the connectivity banner and admin health page at the real GET /health, remove fabricated readiness data.

result.note: healthReady() (health.ts) now calls GET /health instead of the never-mounted GET /health/ready. Removed getReadinessSnapshot/toSnapshotFromOk/toSnapshotFromDegraded and AdminHealthSnapshot/Readiness* types -- existed only to fabricate database/scheduler statuses from a 503/404 that never corresponded to real subsystem data. healthApi.get (GET /api/v1/health, confirmed dead code) left untouched, explicitly out of scope. useApiConnectivity.ts's contract with healthReady() unchanged, no edits needed there. HealthDashboardPage.tsx degrades honestly: a LIVE/UNREACHABLE badge from real GET /health, plus a plain readiness-not-available panel stating per-subsystem readiness isn't available yet (pending S6) -- no fabricated status, QueryStateBoundary wrapping preserved (required by the missing-query-state-boundary guard, initially removed then restored after the guard caught it). sh05-06.shell.e2e.spec.ts updated to stub /health instead of /health/ready. docs/frontend/contract-gaps.md row 15 annotated in place (not rewritten). New/updated tests: health.test.ts, useApiConnectivity.test.ex, ApiConnectivityBanner.test.tsx, HealthDashboardPage.test.tsx -- covering the real endpoint switch, banner show/hide correctness, and the honest not-available-yet panel (never fake data). Verification: npm run test -- 36 test files, 199 tests, all passed; npm run type-check clean; npm run lint clean, 0 warnings; npm run guards -- 48 tests passed including source-scan/bundle-scan. No live dev instance reachable (docker compose denied, no backend listening) -- verification unit/static-level only, permitted since no instance was already up. Backend confirmation: git diff --stat shows only contract-gaps.md and 4 files under web/; lib/letflow/router.ex and all other backend files untouched. SECURITY-REVIEWER out of scope: frontend-only health-check UI change, no tenant-data path.
